purpose: Near-black curtain depth layer behind the Turn
prompt:
An abstract stage-lighting texture. Narrow beams of warm amber light (#F5A524, #FFC15C) cutting at a shallow angle through dark theatrical haze against a deep blue-black ground (#070A12). Volumetric shafts with soft falloff, dust motes catching the light, gentle chromatic bloom at the beam edges. A faint deep crimson (#8B1E3F) undertone in the darkest regions suggesting curtain velvet without depicting fabric. Even distribution across the frame with no single dominant focal point. Restrained, elegant, cinematic. Purely abstract light and atmosphere.

Heavy dark theatre curtain fabric, photographed in near-darkness. Deep vertical folds in almost-black blue-charcoal (#0A0D14), extremely low contrast, with only the faintest warm rim catching two fold edges at the far left. Ninety percent of the frame is pure shadow with no detail. Very dark, very quiet, barely legible. Absolutely no people, no words, no logos.

ee1.inspected: File opened and viewed. Not judged from filename, prompt or metadata.
ee1.rationale: Curtain folds under a warm beam, with pronounced magenta and crimson bands through the centre. The direction runs two colours — stage blue and rationed amber — and §10 bans decorative colour outright. The near-black depth it was made for is produced by the ground tokens for nothing.

ee2.inspected: File opened and viewed, then checked against the rendered page in a browser.
ee2.narrativeJob: The Turn — cloth in a raking beam: the wings she is standing behind
ee2.rationale: Compositionally correct for the last beat before she steps out. Carried at saturate(0.35): the plate has pronounced magenta and crimson through its centre, outside the two-colour palette. Desaturating in the browser removes the cast and keeps the composition — the alternative was rejecting a right frame over a hue.
ee2.delivery: next/image, AVIF/WebP, lazy, responsive sizes. Source JPEG is never served.
